definition: Racter is an artificial intelligence program that generates English language prose at random.
details: It was published by Mindscape for IBM PC compatibles in 1984, then for the Apple II, Mac, and Amiga. An expanded version of the software, not the one released through Mindscape, was used to generate the text for the published book The Policeman's Beard Is Half Constructed.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. That pattern-earned fluency is Racter.
